It supports processing files offline on your own desktop PC, no need to upload files on cloud, also save network bandwidth. It supports several advanced features for documents processing such as more than 50 types of documents ; images conversion support, view more than 170 types of files on your own desktop, extract images, text, metadata from Microsoft Office, compare document files, Sign popular file formats using barcode, QR, stamp and digital sign the documents and many
Softdir.biz is torrent search engine using the fenopy API.

Egnyte and DocuSign integration is the easiest and the most secure way to collaborate on 100% of your files irrespective of where they live, on-prem or in the cloud. Using this app, users can directly send business documents for electronic signatures to both internal and external parties and maintain versioning and annotation on signed documents for easy future reference.
The mashup of discogs.com and filestube.com. Find the whole discography of your favorite artist or band in seconds and download links as well.
Politics in Korea lists all politicians and bills in South Korea. It currently contains over 14,000 candidates and elected officials of the National Assembly Election.
SharedBook used its API and Google widgets to build Blog2Print, a new blog printing widget that can be used by writers and their readers to turn blog posts into books.
Kijiji is a group of local, community-based classifieds websites.
Mashup of Citysearch and Google Maps to help find the best restaurants, hotels, nightlife, shopping and services in major US cities as voted on Citysearch.com.
Allows Box.net users to send files from their Box accounts to Fuze Meeting, where they can discuss and collaborate around them with other users.
Collaborative urban resource mapping.
Combines Flickr, Last.fm and YouTube. Create your own folders, drag your videos, and view videos in a player.
This is a plugin supporting Youtube for Showtime. The idea of the plugin is to allow users to do anything they can do with Youtube official website.

Helps users find RSS feeds and autogenerates OPML files. Uses Windows Live Search API. Facilitates selecting feeds from root weblogs or comments feeds per user selection with support for international markets.
Twups is a twitter aggregator, pulling the most popular twitter topics into one place, so you can keep up to date on what is going on in the world, via twitter.
WishAlert.me monitors your Amazon.com wishlist for price drops and sends you an SMS alert when it finds one.
Provides tracking information of DHL packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Art Galleries, museums, and art fairs in Dallas, Texas.
BookSteam Online Scheduling is an online appointment management platform that allows clients to schedule and manage appointments themselves. This mashup was created using the vCita API.
GrabEvery is shopping price comparison site with a coupons and coupon codes. Several millions of products from thousands of stores on one place.

Find Best Three is a buying suggestion and amazon product comparison tool. We choose the three best goods from different categories and compare them side by side. Besides, we pick up video reviews, photos and other information to answer a question of who is the best?
Browse landmarks and other locations in London with this application that combines Google Earth, Google Maps and Wikipedia.
Good mashup that plots fun and entertaining quotes from Overheard in New York on a Google Map.
InformScan provides a free people search engine that includes public records, emails, US addresses, phone numbers and more.
A simple app to remember must-visit restaurants. Whether you hear about a new place from a friend, blog, or by walking by, Matchbook will help you remember it later.
A lightweight Flickr viewer. You can search and browse photos by users, contacts, photosets, tags, or groups. If the photo is geotagged, it can also be mapped.
Map spanish golf courses with prices depending on the date.
Think College is expensive then check out these preschools where tuition starts at 30,000 dollars US.
Italian public jobs search engine and map. The jobs are grabbed from the Gazzetta Ufficiale.
Plots the location of over 130 zoos, safari parks, butterfly farms and other wildlife attractions throughout the UK.
An interactive African tourist guide providing rich interactive content. Built using Microsoft Silverlight along with Google Maps.
App lets you add random jokes to your Facebook Profile. Jokes come from a Google API-based site.

Free things to see, get and do in London.

Everyone knows texting and driving is dangerous, yet when a text message comes in, it's difficult not to respond. AT&T DriveMode is a free* app that silences incoming text message alerts so you can stay focused while driving. The AT&T DriveMode iOS App for iPhone uses the In-App Messaging API to send auto replies on behalf of the driver indicating the driver is on the road and unavailable to text. The AT&T Webhooks Notifications API provides push notifications for the AT&T DriveMode iOS App. *Data and messaging rates apply

Best beaches, diving, parks, pictures from the island of Okinawa, Japan. See virtual images, panoramas, and aerial photographs of places to visit. Pictures link to reviews, driving directions, maps, and slideshows.

Park reviews for national and state parks. Includes option to mark favorite places to share with others.
Free real estate search site using Google Maps, Streetview and Bing's Bird's eye view. Shows properties in Argentina, Spain and Uruguay.

Find out what time around the world using Google Maps.

AwayFind is a powerful web application that finds your most important emails. When you receive an urgent message, AwayFind will notify you with a call, SMS, IM, DM (Twitter), or delegate the message to someone you specify.
Island Eye has been created to achieve a focal island portal specializing in the History and Tourism of the Isle of Wight. It also helps support Island businesses and voluntary sectors.
Get a list of frequent words/phrases used by specific twitter users.
Human Pets is a social site where veryone on Human Pets is an animal. You can be fed, combed, pet, taken on trips, nicknamed, and others.
